headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts In Fresh Turnover As Stlican Shelf Reignites
war_summary: Severe clashes have erupted anew across Weathered Expanse, where eleven base transitions were recorded in the past two hours alone as Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch churn through brutal contest. Nearby in Stlican Shelf, the front reignited with three fresh exchanges at Fort Hoarfrost amidst accelerating casualty rates on both sides. By contrast, the fighting in Linn of Mercy has fallen abruptly quiet following the earlier Colonial capture of Rotdust, registering negligible attrition over the same stretch. Massive bloodletting persists without immediate territorial swings in Mooring County, where over sixteen hundred soldiers fell in two hours along heavily entrenched lines. To the west, Nevish Line continues to register sharp, accelerating losses as both armies grapple for leverage around Grief Mother, while Callahan’s Passage sustains steady, heavy attrition. Farther south in Palantine Berm, combat has tapered slightly following midnight skirmishes, leaving Colonial forces clinging to their hard-won foothold. With bases flipping rapidly along the northeastern salient, the front lines remain acutely volatile.
